tool_time.basis: Union of reported tool-runtime intervals per session; concurrent sessions add. Intervals end at source timestamp when available, otherwise stored event timestamp (approximate placement). Explicit wait-only time is excluded. This is observed tool occupancy, not total agent thinking or active time.
